name: folio
title: Folio
description: Search memory, list recent meetings, add tasks, and start recordings — all from Raycast. Wraps the local folio-cli.
author: folio

commands.name: search-memory
commands.title: Search Memory
commands.subtitle: Folio
commands.description: Search your local Folio memory index by free-text query.

commands.name: recent-meetings
commands.title: Recent Meetings
commands.subtitle: Folio
commands.description: List the most recent Folio recording sessions and reveal them in Finder.

commands.name: add-task
commands.title: Add Task
commands.subtitle: Folio
commands.description: Append a task to your Folio tasks file with a title and optional owner / due.

commands.name: start-recording
commands.title: Start Recording
commands.subtitle: Folio
commands.description: Open the Folio app via the folio:// deep link and start a new meeting recording.

preferences.name: folioCli
preferences.title: folio-cli path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the folio-cli binary. Defaults to `folio-cli` on $PATH.

preferences.name: vault
preferences.title: Folio vault
preferences.description: Path to the vault root (the parent of recordings/, tasks/, memory/).
